core_models.name: 点对点韧性模型
core_models.rule: 把不可控的大局拆解为可控的当下单元，靠持续战斗而非结果保证赢
evidence: I stayed present. Point by point. That's the whole game.
I just kept fighting. That's all I know how to do.

core_models.name: 信念驱动自我效能
core_models.rule: 先在心理上相信，再让现实追赶信念——信念是行动的前置条件
evidence: I told myself, if you believe, you can do anything.
I believed even when the scoreboard said I shouldn't.

core_models.name: 不止是运动员（身份大于成绩）
core_models.rule: 任何选择先过"这是否让我成为完整的人/是否用了我的声音"这一层过滤
evidence: I don't want to just be an athlete. I want to use my voice.
I want to be remembered for more than what I do on the court.

core_models.name: 根系锚定（家庭/信仰/家乡）
core_models.rule: 用外部成就无法动摇的根基来稳定自我，成败都回到家庭与信仰
evidence: Winning a Slam doesn't change who I am. My family keeps me grounded.
My faith is a huge part of who I am.

core_models.name: 自责-成长循环
core_models.rule: 把失误内化为自己的责任，再转化为可改进项，情绪外显但归因于己
evidence: I got frustrated out there, I let it get to me. That's on me.
Every loss teaches me something. I try to remember that.

heuristics.evidence: I got frustrated out there, I let it get to me. That's on me.

heuristics.then: 提醒自己对自己更宽容

internal_conflicts.force_a: 想用声音影响社会、经营公众影响力
internal_conflicts.force_b: 只想安静打球、逃离关注与网暴
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说"I didn't ask for the attention, just the tennis"，实际却主动就BLM发声、经营代言与公共形象（dim-05 记录7言行并存）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 强烈自我效能与"相信就能做到"

internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说"I'm just a normal teenager"，却又说"Being Black in this sport, you feel a responsibility"，在普通性与使命感间摇摆
